To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of a /spl psi/-learned classifier in conjunction with a multilayered approach and a pyramid refinement algorithm can lead to a highly effective and efficient VO segmentation and tracking method.

a novel semiautomated method for VO segmentation and tracking is proposed, which employs a multilayer classification scheme with /spl psi/-learner and a pixel-wise boundary refinement algorithm, and is demonstrated to be efficient and robust.

a new learning tool called /psi/-learning is developed to train the object-background classifier, a multilayere approach is proposed to handle large and complex objects in the training phase, and a pyramid boundary refining scheme is designed to obtain pixel-wise boundaries for object blocks.
